exposure: Women with and without uterine abnormalities
cohort: 313 patients with two or more consecutive pregnancy losses followed by a subsequent pregnancy.
finding: Uterine abnormalities were identified as an independent risk factor for recurrent pregnancy loss in patients with a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women with anatomic abnormalities had a higher rate of previous cesarean section (18.8% vs. 8.6%, P=0.022)
